title: Build and verify native Apple Silicon FreeCAD executable
description: Build the current project source with its locked Pixi macOS environment and Release CMake preset. Verify CLI, representative CAD operations, native tests, and GUI launch; provide executable and local app launcher paths.
close_reason: Built native arm64 Release executables from c45b4e2332 with the locked Pixi environment. Verified CLI imports, boolean solids, constrained sketch and pad, FCStd save/reopen, STEP exchange, Finder .app launch, Part/Sketcher/PartDesign/BIM activation and actual 3D rendering. Native tests: 2167 passed across full run and serial retry, 2 existing skips and 8 existing disabled tests. Parallel MoveProperty test file collisions recorded as FreeCAD-az1. Executables and local launchers are in build/release; generated binaries remain local.

title: Isolate MoveProperty test files for parallel CTest runs
description: The Apple Silicon Release build from c45b4e2332 passes CLI modeling/file exchange and GUI workbench/render checks. In ctest --parallel 4, MoveProperty.undoExpressionOriginatingContainerOtherDoc, MoveProperty.redoExpressionTargetContainer, and MoveProperty.redoExpressionOriginatingContainerOtherDoc failed while using shared test.FCStd/test1.FCStd files from tests/src/App/Property.cpp:554. The log reports a missing-file rename during backup creation. All three passed with ctest --rerun-failed --parallel 1 in the same environment. Give each fixture unique temporary paths or use a CTest resource lock. Evidence: build/release/ctest.log and build/release/ctest-rerun-failed.log.
